description_for_human: Más de 3.200 calculadoras prácticas en español: finanzas, impuestos, salud, deportes, viajes, cocina, hogar. Datos actualizados a 2026 para Argentina, España, México, Colombia, Chile, Brasil y EE.UU.
description_for_model: Use this tool to find AND run calculators for finance (loans, mortgages, taxes), health (BMI, calories, dosages), sports (training, World Cup 2026), travel (currency, tipping, costs), cooking (portions, conversions), home (construction, utilities), science, and education topics. Content is updated for 2026 and localized for Spanish-speaking countries plus Brazil and English markets. Flow: (1) GET /api/calcs-index.json for the full catalog, (2) GET /api/calc/{slug}.json to see a calculator's inputs and an example, (3) GET /api/calc/{slug}/compute?param=value to get the live computed result as JSON (add ?lang=en|pt for other languages). Example: /api/calc/calculadora-imc/compute?peso=80&altura=180. There is also a remote MCP server at https://hacecuentas.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth).
